post.description:
Parse pasted slip text into editable legs; resolve only exact, unique provider matches.

If the provider catalog cannot be read, every leg stays unresolved with CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.
Analyze a RESOLVED stored slip and persist an immutable analysis record.

get.description: A stored analysis exactly as saved, with every snapshot it cites.

post.description: Validate and normalize a slip without persisting it. 422 on invalid input.

provider_failures.title: Provider Failures
provider_failures.description: Every failed or stale provider call from all evidence snapshots.

AnalysisRecord.title: AnalysisRecord
AnalysisRecord.description: A stored analysis with every snapshot it cites, as persisted (POST and GET are identical).

AnalysisRequest.title: AnalysisRequest

as_of_utc.title: As Of Utc
as_of_utc.description: Data cutoff: nothing newer was used.

code_version.title: Code Version
code_version.description: Git commit of the analysis code.

AnalysisRun.title: AnalysisRun
AnalysisRun.description: Complete, auditable record of one analysis of one saved slip. Immutable once stored.

event_start_utc.title: Event Start Utc
event_start_utc.description: Event start; any offset accepted, stored and returned as UTC.

original_input.title: Original Input
original_input.description: Verbatim user submission, kept for audit.

gross_payout_usd.title: Gross Payout Usd
gross_payout_usd.description: Quoted payout including returned stake; semantics confirmed per market.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Canonical event identity. `event_id` is the id carried by `BetLeg.event_id`.

evidence_id.title: Evidence Id
evidence_id.description: SHA-256 of all other fields; auto-filled.

derived_from.title: Derived From
derived_from.description: evidence_ids an INFERENCE was derived from.

snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id
snapshot_id.description: SHA-256 of all other fields; auto-filled.

EvidenceSnapshot.title: EvidenceSnapshot
EvidenceSnapshot.description: The exact evidence used for one event at one moment. Never mutated; newer data = new one.

break_even_probability.title: Break Even Probability
break_even_probability.description: May exceed 1: no probability breaks even.

FeatureObservation.title: FeatureObservation
FeatureObservation.description: One feature value. Set at most one of the two values; neither means "source says unknown".

InsufficientData.title: InsufficientData
InsufficientData.description: No responsible estimate is possible; `reasons` says why, in plain language.

IntakeError.title: IntakeError
IntakeError.description: Provider-independent error envelope for requests that cannot be read at all.

slip.description: Present only when state is RESOLVED; ready for analysis.

bet_slip_id.title: Bet Slip Id
bet_slip_id.description: Stored slip snapshot; present only when state is RESOLVED.

consensus_probability.title: Consensus Probability
consensus_probability.description: De-vigged external consensus, when books were available.

LegAnalysis.title: LegAnalysis
LegAnalysis.description: One leg's result plus the exact snapshots it was computed from.

LegDraft.title: LegDraft
LegDraft.description: Editable leg. Fields mirror BetLeg; unknown values stay null rather than guessed.

market_type.description: None when the provider type has no normalized equivalent.

Market.title: Market
Market.description: Provider market identity. A different line is a different market.

price_usd.title: Price Usd
price_usd.description: Per-share price in USD; None if unusable.

MarketSnapshot.title: MarketSnapshot
MarketSnapshot.description: One observation of a market's tradable state. Unknowns stay None and add a warning.

assumption.title: Assumption
assumption.default: treats legs as independent; wrong whenever legs share a dependency

NaiveIndependentBaseline.title: NaiveIndependentBaseline
NaiveIndependentBaseline.description: Product of leg probabilities. A comparison baseline only, never a recommendation input.

ProviderFailure.title: ProviderFailure
ProviderFailure.description: A provider that failed during collection; kept so partial failures stay visible.

SourceSnapshot.title: SourceSnapshot
SourceSnapshot.description: Where a fact, quote, or event state came from and when it was retrieved.
